description: The closed lists of the onboarding notes (scripts/onboarding_notes.py, B-411): where a run's own notes live in the project, the phases a run goes through and the phase text each one reads, the skeleton of discovery.yaml, and the words a section or a topic may be in. Code reads this file; it holds no list of its own (FR-13). The notes are the factory's own record of one onboarding run, written as the phases go; they are not project files and git ignores the folder from its first file.
